description: Divisional Secretariat of Rathnapura - Notify the Esala Perahara - 2018 in Ammaduwa Kuda Katharagama Dewalaya in Weligepola and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2087/26 of 05.09.2018, Mahiyanganaya D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the regulation of a religious/cultural festival (Esala Perahara at Ammaduwa Kuda Katharagama Dewalaya). It includes administrative regulations about festival operations, sanitation, health precautions, and site management, but does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit into any of the specialized categories (Types 4-9) such as land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters. It falls under cultural/administrative matters not covered by other categories.
